decisions.reason: Having survived its first review cycle, this core-adjacent camera now likely sits at or near aspiration levels, so with organisational slack and strategic fit management would keep it.
As a modular camera line with several models and a strong fit with existing capabilities, it signals continued commitment and results unlikely to justify redeploying resources away from it.

Its lighter market presentation still makes it the most review-prone among the older products, but its relevance for compact spacecraft sensors and the firm's available slack support retaining it while performance remains uncertain.
This radiation-hard camera line is close to the core business and was launched with a dedicated presentation, so early outcomes are likely to be judged as promising enough to continue.

Because this asteroid navigation and imaging camera is more niche and only tentatively presented, it faces the highest shortfall risk among the 2024 launches, yet its exploratory strategic value and the firm's R&D-oriented slack still favor keeping it for now.
